Merge forward and reverse reads

Source: R/vtamR_fun.R
merge_fastq_pairs.Rd

Merge paired-end FASTQ reads (forward and reverse) and convert the resulting sequences to FASTA format. Output FASTA files can optionally be compressed. The generated fastainfo.csv file is similar to the input fastqinfo file, but FASTQ file columns are replaced by a fasta column containing the names of the output files.

Usage

merge_fastq_pairs(
  fastqinfo,
  fastq_dir,
  outdir,
  vsearch_path = NULL,
  compress_method = "R",
  pigz_path = NULL,
  num_threads = 0,
  fastq_ascii = 33,
  fastq_maxdiffs = 10,
  fastq_maxee = 1,
  fastq_minlen = 50,
  fastq_maxlen = 500,
  fastq_minmergelen = 50,
  fastq_maxmergelen = 1000,
  fastq_maxns = 0,
  fastq_truncqual = 10,
  fastq_minovlen = 50,
  fastq_allowmergestagger = FALSE,
  sep = ",",
  compress = FALSE,
  quiet = T,
  log_file = NULL
)

Arguments

fastqinfo

Data frame or path to a CSV file with the following columns: tag_fw, primer_fw, tag_rv, primer_rv, sample, sample_type (mock/negative/real), habitat (optional), replicate, fastq_fw, fastq_rv.

fastq_dir

Character string specifying the directory containing input FASTQ files (listed in fastqinfo$fastq_fw and fastqinfo$fastq_rv).

outdir

Character string specifying the output directory.

vsearch_path

Optional path to the vsearch executable. If NULL (default), resolved via getOption("vtamR.vsearch_path") or the PATH (see get_path).

compress_method

Character or logical. Compression method: "pigz", "gzip", or "R". "pigz" requires pigz to be installed and available in the system PATH (or specified via pigz_path). "gzip" is available on Linux systems. "R" uses R.utils, which is cross-platform but slower. Relative speed: R.utils < gzip < pigz.

pigz_path

Optional path to the pigz executable. If NULL (default), resolved via getOption("vtamR.pigz_path") or the PATH (see get_path).

num_threads

Positive integer specifying the number of CPU threads to use. If 0, all available CPUs are used.

fastq_ascii

Integer (33 or 64) specifying the ASCII offset used for FASTQ quality scores.

fastq_maxdiffs

Positive integer specifying the maximum number of mismatches allowed in the overlapping region.

fastq_maxee

Positive integer specifying the maximum number of expected errors allowed per sequence.

fastq_minlen

Positive integer specifying the minimum allowed sequence length.

fastq_maxlen

Positive integer specifying the maximum allowed sequence length.

fastq_minmergelen

Positive integer specifying the minimum length of merged sequences.

fastq_maxmergelen

Positive integer specifying the maximum length of merged sequences.

fastq_maxns

Positive integer specifying the maximum number of ambiguous bases (N) allowed per sequence.

fastq_truncqual

Positive integer specifying the quality score threshold for truncating sequences.

fastq_minovlen

Positive integer specifying the minimum overlap length required for merging reads.

fastq_allowmergestagger

Logical. If TRUE, allow merging of staggered read pairs (where the reverse read extends beyond the forward read).

sep

Character string specifying the field separator used in input and output CSV files.

compress

Logical. If TRUE, compress output files using gzip.

quiet

Logical. If TRUE, suppress informational messages and only display warnings or errors.

log_file

Character string specifying the path to the CSV log file. The path is resolved with the following priority:

  1. the log_file argument, if explicitly provided by the user;

  2. the vtamR.log_file option set with options(vtamR.log_file = ...), if set;

  3. "vtamR_log.csv" in the current working directory, used as a last resort if neither of the above is set.

To disable logging entirely, set log_file = NA.

Value

Data frame corresponding to the generated fastainfo.csv file.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
merge_fastq_pairs(
  fastqinfo_df,
  fastq_dir = "data/fastqdir",
  vsearch_path = "C:/Users/Public/vsearch",
  outdir = "data/fastadir",
  compress = TRUE,
  quiet = FALSE
)

merge_fastq_pairs(
  fastqinfo_df,
  fastq_dir = "data/fastqdir",
  outdir = "data/fastadir",
  fastq_maxdiffs = 5,
  fastq_maxee = 2,
  fastq_minlen = 60,
  fastq_maxlen = 100,
  fastq_minmergelen = 80,
  fastq_maxmergelen = 100,
  fastq_maxns = 1,
  fastq_truncqual = 20,
  fastq_minovlen = 20,
  fastq_allowmergestagger = TRUE
)
} # }
